solution_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mrow><mtext>Step 1: Identify the place value of each digit in 8,734,501.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 2: The digit 7 is in the hundred thousands place.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 3: Therefore, its value is 7 × 100,000 = 700,000.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Answer: 700,000.</mtext></mrow></math>
question_text: What is the value of the digit 7 in the number 8,734,501?
solution_text: Step 1: Identify the place value of each digit in 8,734,501. Step 2: The digit 7 is in the hundred thousands place. Step 3: Therefore, its value is 7 × 100,000 = 700,000. Answer: 700,000.
